event_summary: A brown round object and a red rectangular object move downward from overhead holders and come to rest on separate white cushions.
raw_event_description: The video begins with two white cushion-like pads below a dark overhead bar. A brown round object is near a blue holder at the upper left, and a red rectangular object is near an orange-and-dark holder at the upper right. For many frames the scene is still. Later, both objects are seen below their holders with motion blur while moving downward. The brown object reaches the left cushion, and the red rectangular object reaches the right cushion. In the final frames the brown object rests on the left cushion and the red object rests lying flat on the right cushion while the holders remain overhead.

reasons: The brown round object, red rectangular object, overhead holders, and white cushions are all visible.
The first frame shows no visible motion blur on the objects.
The objects are positioned above the cushion surfaces before the later downward motion.
